notes: HumanEval+ contains only 164 problems total (fixed benchmark size); the spec's 200 was impossible without fabrication. Per user decision the 36-problem gap was reallocated to MBPP (MBPP 387, HumanEval+ 163).
HumanEval+ 163 (not 164): HumanEval/32 excluded as non-deterministic (see excluded list).

APPS: only stdin/stdout problems are included (task_type=stdin_stdout). Call-based APPS problems (input_output contains 'fn_name') were excluded by design since the spec requires APPS to be stdin/stdout. APPS train has few pure-stdin problems, so introductory problems were supplemented from the APPS test split.

APPS/CodeContests: every included problem's reference solution was executed against its tests; only problems whose reference solution reproduces the exact expected stdout were kept (this also filters non-deterministic / multiple-valid-output / special-judge problems).
CodeContests reference solutions are official accepted PYTHON3 (language==3) submissions; difficulty derived from cf_rating (<1300 easy, 1300-1699 medium, 1700+ hard, unrated -> competition).
MBPP/HumanEval+ have no per-problem difficulty metadata in the source, so human_difficulty is null for those sources (not invented).
Recommended evaluator timeout: >=30s per problem. humaneval_plus_139 (special_factorial) reference runs ~11s due to large-integer factorial test inputs.
HumanEval+ tests are the official EvalPlus check functions (they import numpy); each record's tests[0] is the full check plus a call check(<entry_point>).

validation_summary.method: Every reference solution was executed against its tests (function: assertions; stdin_stdout: subprocess stdin->stdout exact match after trailing-whitespace normalization).
